title: Ephemeral certificate provisioner and graceful connection-drain Terraform module for internal NLB/ALB
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Problem: Private (VPC) deployments currently rely on long-lived certificates and manual cert rotation for internal ALB/NLB TLS termination. Upgrades (blue/green and canary) and node replacement can cause brief client connection failures and administrative overhead. We need a Terraform module that provisions ephemeral TLS certificates, coordinates certificate rotation with connection draining, and supports both ALB TLS termination and NLB TLS passthrough modes for internal ingress in private VPCs.

Goals:
- Provide a reusable Terraform module that can: create ALB listeners with managed ephemeral certs, attach NLB listeners for passthrough, and wire up connection-drain hooks for instances and target groups.
- Automate ephemeral cert issuance (internal CA + short TTL or ACME integration for internal PKI) and transparent rotation without traffic disruption.
- Ensure graceful drain semantics: session stickiness, cross-zone drain awareness, connection termination grace period, and healthcheck alignment to avoid premature replacement.
- Backwards-compatible upgrade path from existing ingress module to avoid forcing wide-scale infra changes.
- Emit operational telemetry: cert age, rotation events, drain latency, failed-rotations, and target-health drift.

Design notes:
- Module inputs: listener_type (alb|nlb), tls_mode (termination|passthrough), cert_provider (internal_ca|acme|external_arn), cert_ttl_seconds, drain_grace_seconds, enable_cross_zone_stickiness, sni_map (map of hostname->target_group).
- Module outputs: listener_arns, active_cert_id, last_rotation_timestamp, drain_job_id. (Note: outputs will be flattened strings; complex state is kept in remote state and in CloudWatch/Stackdriver tags.)
- Rotation strategy: staggered short-lived certs (default 24h TTL), pre-provision new certs, attach to new listener, shift weights to new targets, enable target drain, wait for zero active connections (or drain_grace_seconds timeout), swap, then remove old certs. Fallback: if rotation fails after N retries, fallback to previous cert + alert and rollback.
- Healthchecks: align ALB target group healthcheck thresholds with drain grace; expose a drift detector that flags when unhealthy targets remain after grace window.
- Security: private CA keys stored in customer KMS/HSM (for Private deployment), module supports external cert ARN for customers with existing KMS. Security review required for any ACME integration.

Compatibility and migration:
- Provide a migration script that can import existing ALB listeners and attach ephemeral cert lifecycle without downtime using a canary target group and phased traffic shifting.
- Document Known Incompatibilities: legacy session affinity implementations that rely on sticky cookies with long TTLs may require adjustments. NLB passthrough mode cannot perform TLS rotation at ALB level; module will orchestrate node-level certs and requires agent on instances for hot-reload.

Testing plan:
- Unit test suite for Terraform module with terratest: listener creation, outputs, and input validation.
- Integration test in staging VPC: ALB termination flow, NLB passthrough flow, simulated cert rotation failover.
- Chaos test: replace targets during rotation while synthetic clients maintain long-lived connections to validate graceful drain.

Observability and alerts:
- CloudWatch metrics published: CertRotation.Success{1|0}, CertRotation.DurationSeconds, Drain.DurationSeconds, TargetsLeftAfterDrain.Count.
- Alerting rules: RotationFailures > 1 in 1h => Sev2, TargetsLeftAfterDrain > 0 past drain_grace_seconds => Sev1 for customer-facing private deployments.

acceptance_criteria: Terraform module published to infra registry with documented inputs/outputs and examples for ALB and NLB modes.
Migration helper script that upgrades existing ALB listeners without downtime and documented rollback steps.
Terratest integration tests pass in staging and chaos test shows <1% client-visible failures under heavy connection churn.
Security review completed and sign-off obtained for ACME usage in Private deployments or ACME disabled by default.
Dashboards and alerts deployed in production monitoring namespace for rotation failures and drain anomalies.
